papers.title: BDH-CQ: In-Context Learning with Recurrent Latent Reasoning
papers.summary: We introduce BDH-CQ, a reasoning model that combines in-context learning with recurrent latent reasoning. papers.summary: Leading large language model providers now conceal their models' step-by-step reasoning, or chain-of-thought, to protect intellectual property and limit information leakage. papers.summary: We introduce Sci-VBench, a comprehensive benchmark for evaluating knowledge- and reasoning-intensive video generation across scientific domains. papers.title: Evo-Bench: Can Language Models Improve Agent Harness?

papers.title: Ego-OSCAR: Egocentric Open source Stereo CAptuRe System

papers.title: MatrAIx: Simulating the World with 8.3 Billion Persona Agents
